name: Alessia Bellini
bio:
Alessia's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly during a university project focused on automotive design. Captivated by the artistry and precision involved in vehicle aesthetics, she specialized in paint technology. After graduating from Politecnico di Milano, Alessia honed her skills at a custom car shop, where she learned to blend traditional techniques with cutting-edge materials.

Joining Cool Racing was a dream come true. Alessia is meticulous in her approach, understanding that a flawless paint job isn't just about aesthetics; it contributes to the car's aerodynamic performance. She constantly experiments with new coatings and application methods to gain every possible advantage on the track. Her colleagues value her attention to detail and her ability to remain calm under pressure, even when deadlines are tight.

Alessia is quickly becoming known for her ability to translate complex aerodynamic requirements into visually stunning designs. Her understanding of color theory and surface textures allows her to create paint schemes that not only look fantastic but also enhance the car's overall performance.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a high ponytail
physical.description: Alessia is of average height with a focused, intense gaze.

quirks: Always wears noise-canceling headphones, even when not operating machinery.
Has a collection of miniature paint cans representing every color she's ever used.
Meticulously cleans her workstation at the end of each day, regardless of how busy she is.
